description: Scaleway's OpenAPI export drops query parameters that belong to a proto `oneOf`, so `ListLocalImages` lose filters the API takes. The official JS SDK sends them through `resolveOneOf` in `urlParams` — scaleway-sdk-js packages_generated/marketplace/src/v2/api.gen.ts — with the types in the sibling types.gen.ts. They are added as optional query members; the API enforces the one-of. Live on 2026-10-12, a call with none of them answered `invalid_arguments` "One of image_id, image_label or version_id required".

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Local images of this marketplace image ID. One-of `scope`: exactly one of `image_id`, `version_id`, `image_label` — the API rejects a call with none.
Local images of this marketplace version ID. One-of `scope`: exactly one of `image_id`, `version_id`, `image_label` — the API rejects a call with none.
Local images of this marketplace image label (`ubuntu_noble`). One-of `scope`: exactly one of `image_id`, `version_id`, `image_label` — the API rejects a call with none.
